source_dataset: Google Smartphone Decimeter 2022 local train subset
selection_basis: Session/device diversity plus causal runtime-only WLS displacement-speed and gyroscope magnitude. No ground-truth rows or error outcomes were read before these windows were frozen.

adaptation.resampling: right-closed trailing-bin arithmetic mean; output at bin end; only source timestamps <= output timestamp
adaptation.gravity_estimate: causal first-order low-pass direction from accelerometer, normalized to 9.80665 m/s^2
adaptation.attitude: causal gravity plus calibrated uncalibrated-magnetometer basis; a fixed device-horizontal motion axis is the principal horizontal acceleration axis from the strictly pre-blackout 60-second runtime IMU window
adaptation.yaw_alignment: circular mean of causal 5-second WLS course minus simultaneous magnetic inferred-axis heading over the strictly pre-blackout 60-second calibration interval; the axis eigenvector sign ambiguity is thereby resolved without labels
adaptation.map_matching: not applicable outside the S1 map region
adaptation.phase7: not applicable: WLS positions provide no defensible per-fix accuracy field required by the frozen Phase 7 validator

scenarios.selection_evidence: Lowest 10-second mean gyroscope magnitude among moving candidate windows: approximately 0.012 rad/s; causal WLS speed median approximately 5.6 m/s.
Highest 30-second mean gyroscope magnitude among moving candidates: approximately 0.228 rad/s; causal WLS speed median approximately 10.6 m/s.
Independent interior 60-second segment with causal WLS speed median approximately 27.1 m/s and mean gyroscope magnitude approximately 0.110 rad/s.
Second device/location; high 30-second runtime gyroscope activity approximately 0.130 rad/s and causal WLS speed median approximately 16.3 m/s.
